description: accessors-smart provides an ASM-based helper for generating fast bean accessors for getter, setter, constructor, and field access operations. It is used by json-smart to reduce the overhead of Java reflection when mapping and converting object properties.

skipped-versions.reason: net.minidev:accessors-smart:2.4.3 was published to Maven Central without its binary jar (only the POM, sources, javadoc and a dangling accessors-smart-2.4.3.jar.asc exist), so the version cannot be resolved or tested; 2.4.6 is the next release with a published jar.
